ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in linear disruptions and at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. The central and medial regions consist of a solid low-intensity black field interrupted by thin, high-contrast white linear segments.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes detected along the entire trailing edge; most pronounced peaks are observed at the left and right distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep across the main lobe body, ending in a sharp concave taper at the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels resembling circular colonization scars are visible on the outermost margins and tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the black pigment, particularly concentrated on the left lobe and near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear white scarring (rake marks) distributed across the ventral surface; distinct jagged erosion of the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated high-intensity white pigmentation 'caps' at the extreme lateral tips contrasting sharply with the primary dark pigmentation.
